notes.title: Sands of Time DLC – Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,



It has been a busy stretch of production, and we want to take a moment to share where things stand with the Sands of Time DLC for Elleria: Book I.

The DLC has grown into something much larger than originally envisioned—expanding the world of Elleria with new lore, cinematic moments, and original music. A great deal of work is going into ensuring the fantasy atmosphere remains deep, immersive, and true to the tone of the main game.

Here’s what’s been happening:

Visuals & Cinematics: We’ve been creating new renders, animations, especially environmental ones and vision sequences that will bring the desert setting and its mysteries to life.

Music & Atmosphere: A fully new soundtrack is in progress, tailored to match both the awe-inspiring and ominous tones of the story. As always, being very firm about music and believing it contributes heavily to overall atmosphere and story, Sands of Time currently stands above 20 soundtracks tailored for it.

Narrative & Lore: The Sands of Time storyline expands on themes of fate, time, and forgotten powers tying directly into Eliot’s journey and what awaits beyond Book I.

This DLC is not just an “add-on”—it’s part of a larger vision leading toward Book II, giving both long-time players and newcomers more reasons to dive deeper into Elleria’s universe. Rest assured we're currently working way over the clock, to deliver this as fast as possible.



And now for something special we’re sharing one of the Sands of Time OST tracks:

🎶 Vaerith – The Veiled Daughter

This piece captures her presence perfectly: majestic, inevitable, and quietly awe-inspiring. It’s one of our personal favorites, and we can’t wait for you to hear it!

notes.title: v1.5 Update – The Wheel Turns Again
notes.notes:
📜 v1.5 – Wheel of Fate \[DLC Update]
🔹 The story continues with The Wheel Unbroken
– New regions. New choices. Death itself has taken notice... and now demands an audience.
– New achievements added!
– The Prologue and Chapter II – Part II have been polished: grammar fixes, sentence rewrites, and a full pass over earlier chapters. Everything now reads smoother than ever.
– Fixed an issue where Prologue images refused to load properly (they’ve been disciplined).
– The Music Room has been updated with Wheel of Fate tracks for your listening pleasure.
– Cloud Save support is now live!

🔹 Miscellaneous Fixes & Improvements
– Squashed a few typos. The Blight keeps attacking... but it won’t win.
– Fixed missing achievements. The Inquisition concluded their investigation—the culprit was set on fire. (By divine order, of course. We consider this a learning moment.)
– Even more new music tracks have been added!
– Codex updates and fresh entries are in. Paladins are now allowed to borrow sacred scrolls and learn more about the world—just don’t forget to return them after reading!

📘 Codex Highlights
World Lore:
– The Aspects, The Gods, The Chosen, The Stone Tongue, and The Holy Order of The One.
Places:
– Numerous new entries on key regions across Elleria.

notes.title: v1.3.2 [HOTFIX] – The Renderer Rebellion
notes.notes:
v1.3.2 – Wheel of Fate [Hotfix]

Some players encountered a rare but critical crash after naming their character, caused by:

TypeError: '<=' not supported between instances of 'NoneType' and 'float'

Why did it happen?

This occurs only on specific setups where a combination of GPU drivers + Ren'Py’s default (gl3/ANGLE) renderer + certain UI transforms causes instability — particularly on Steam Deck and newer GPUs.

Fixes in this hotfix:


 🔧 Renderer fallback updated to use gl2 and a stable 60 FPS cap. 


This improves compatibility for Steam Deck, Linux, and modern graphics cards. 
No performance impact for players who weren’t affected.

If you’re still experiencing issues, you can also manually launch the game with this in your Steam launch options: 

--renderer gl2 --framerate 60

notes.title: Elleria: Wheel of Fate - v1.3 Update Live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101741/a881a772cb403ac255e027ffd9a7ef7e6fcf76c4.png

Elleria: Wheel of Fate DLC - v1.3 Update Now Live!

The Wheel of Fate DLC for Elleria has received its first update, with all three promised acts now completed! The update includes not just brand-new content but a series of improvements and fixes to enhance your experience. Check out the changes below:

What's New in v1.3 - Wheel of Fate DLC:

Chapter Updates:


 Chapter 1, Chapter 1 Part 2, and Chapter 1 Finale:
 
 Reworked sentences, fixed typos, corrected grammar, and improved overall structure.
 
 Chapter 2:
 
 Reworked sentences, fixed typos, corrected grammar, and improved structure.
 
 Re-Post Processing of Chapters:
 
 Intro, Prologue, Chapter I, II, III up to the last chapter.
 
 All renders have been re-post processed and enhanced. While this may slightly impact file size, it improves overall visuals.
 Example: Some past scenes were too dark, now we've given the people of Elleria some candles! You'll notice the improvement.


New Story:

[olist]
 New story and expanded lore—expansion is more fitting here!
[/olist]

DLC Soundtracks:


 New DLC soundtracks have been added, providing fresh auditory immersion.
 
 Main Character Design Rework:
 
 Rework of main character design to better match the evolving narrative and world.


GUI Tweaks:


 Tweaks to improve overall user interface experience.
 
 Codex World Lore Section Update:
 
 Codex World Lore section updated with new information. ( Wheel of Fate )


Textbox Changes and Python Script Fix:


 Fixed issues with the cached textbox in the Python script.
 
 Update to Ren'Py 8.3.7 and Python 3:
 
 Updated to Ren'Py 8.3.7 and Python 3 for improved stability and functionality.


Recoding of Definitions:


 Recoded numerous definitions to ensure proper initialization.


Wheel of Fate (HUD Update):

 Wheel of Fate is now displayed on the HUD and can be clicked for updates on its state.
 
 You can drag the pop-up box that appears around the screen.
 
 Check it often: Not every change will be visually represented on the wheel, so keep an eye on it for subtle shifts.


Wheel of Fate DLC Content:

 "The Council Reforms"
 
 "Demonic Negotiations"
 
 "Rebuilding the Human Realms"
 Available with the first update of this DLC.


50 Million Unique Story Permutations:


 With over 50 million unique story permutations, each playthrough can turn out completely different. There's practically endless replay value as every choice ripples across the world in its own way.
 
 Blends Deep Strategy with Visual Novel Storytelling:
 
 Navigate political machinations and battlefield tactics, then dive into rich character-driven scenes—this DLC fuses grand strategy and classic VN beats into one seamless experience. And we're just getting started!


Changes to Silas on Feedback:

 Silas content is now optional and can be skipped, as some players were bothered by having two characters to play. All Silas content is now skippable and the same will apply in future updates.
 
 Silas was never meant to replace main character Eliot, but was created to give the player a deeper understanding of the world, lore, and how certain actions taken by Eliot make sense.
 
 Silas content is now optional, but skipping it may result in missing important story details.


Step into the Wheel of Fate!


 The Wheel of Fate spins with every choice you make. The gods defied The One, triggering the Divine Schism, and now you must face the consequences of your actions. Your crusade has started, but it is far from over.  With all three promised acts and new content, this update will immerse you further into the Wheel of Fate story and new lore, where every action echoes through time.
 
 Download the update now and experience the world of Elleria in a deeper and more engaging way!


Disclaimer: Elleria: Wheel of Fate DLC contains mature themes, including violence, substances, and complex moral choices. Please be aware of these elements as you continue your journey.

Before leaving the patch notes below, along with the new changes and/or additions as always. A small note that I'm listening and watching. 

Especially for your feedbacks/suggestions and/or otherwise. The most noted one so far, that seems to be repeated is regarding the adult scenes... patience is a virtue, knowledge doesn't come overnight. But you'll find one new adult scene in this update, one where I tried to improve upon such scenes. As much as time granted me anyway. But I'll let you judge it , and has it improved in comparison to the past ones. 

I'll wait for your words on it!

See you soon with another one! ( Maybe sooner than you expect! )
